method: Forward/backward LK features; RANSAC similarity motion; confidence >0.6 in all three videos. Acceleration is the first difference of consecutive center translations. RMS averages x and y components. Jitter uses a 2.4-frame Gaussian high-pass on integrated center translations. No zoom normalization; the new video is more tightly cropped (1.25x), so these values penalize its magnification. Previous export has variable zoom. These are motion proxies and include deliberate camera movement.
